title: Matsue Tourism Association — City Centre

facts.fact: The central area is divided by the Ohashi River; JR Matsue Station and Matsue Shinjiko Onsen are not assumed interchangeable.
facts.excerpt: Matsue City Centre is bisected by the Ohashi River

facts.fact: The city guide places Lake Shinji about one kilometre and the castle about two kilometres from Matsue Station.
facts.excerpt: Lake Shinji is one kilometer away from the station and Matsue Castle is two kilometers

readingScope: Relevant article body and fact excerpts actually read; page capture alone is not treated as editorial verification.
